Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> True or False:
> Actions that target one or more ash heaps are still always undirected.

False.

If an action targets one or more ash heaps and something controlled by another
Methuselah, it would be directed.

Actions that targets only one or more ash heaps are undirected, sure.
